text: A股市场油气股集体上涨，其中，科力股份涨超10%，通源石油涨超6%，中曼石油涨近6%，潜能恒信涨超4%，首华燃气涨超3%，中国海油、和顺石油涨超2%。 消息面上，美伊军事冲突进入第10日，胡塞武装宣布对沙特实施海上封锁，红海曼德海峡通行量两周内骤降34%。国际油价继续上涨，其中，WTI原油期货涨至85.75美元/桶，创6月12日以来新高；布伦特原油期货涨至92.66美元/桶，创6月11日以来新高。
text_en: A-share oil and gas stocks rose collectively, Keli Shares up over 10%, Tongyuan Petroleum up over 6%, Zhongman Petroleum up nearly 6%, Potent Oil up over 4%, Shouhua Gas up over 3%, CNOOC, Heshun Petroleum up over 2%. News: US-Iran military conflict entered day 10, Houthis announced maritime blockade on Saudi Arabia, Red Sea Mandeb Strait traffic dropped 34% in two weeks. International oil prices continued rising, WTI crude futures rose to $85.75/barrel, highest since June 12; Brent crude rose to $92.66/barrel, highest since June 11.
